title: load_or_generate_signing_key takes &Option<String> not Option<&str>
description: server_stores::load_or_generate_signing_key(path: &Option<String>) borrows a String-owning Option. The function only reads the string value; it never needs ownership. Idiomatic Rust: accept Option<&str> (or Option<impl AsRef<str>>). This avoids forcing callers to hold an owned String just to pass a reference, and the match arms become simpler (Some(p) binds &str directly instead of &String). The call site already has config.operator.signing_key_path: Option<String>, so the caller would pass config.operator.signing_key_path.as_deref().
